0022600133.text: The Washington Wizards (2-2, 1-1 on the road, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (2-1, 2-0 at home, on a two-game winning streak) as they look to get back to .500 in their division race, with Washington 1 game back in the Southeast and Cleveland 0.5 games back in the Central. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams haven't met yet this season, but the Wizards lost all four matchups against Cleveland in 2025-26, most recently 130-117 in Cleveland on April 12, 2026.
